about: Accessibility violations the frontend has today, recorded so the scans pass on it and fail on a CHANGE (see README.md in this folder). Fixing one means deleting its entry here in the same pull request; adding one is not allowed except by a deliberate decision. 'nodes' is how many elements axe-core reported. Frontend fixes are tracked separately from #168 (frontend direction: #154).
